name: rpi5-hailo-whisper-tiny
description: Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo-8: Whisper tiny on the HEF encoder at a 10 s window. The lowest-latency option on this board (TTFT ~60 ms) and the best short-form accuracy measured anywhere on it (7.30% WER). Long-form is weaker than base/5s — at a 10 s window a 10-11 s utterance splits into exactly two chunks, so there is one cut and its placement dominates. English only in practice.
